title: Simple World Importer
description: This mod adds a button to the Singleplayer screen that lets you upload a world as a .zip file and quickly add it to your game.
body:
Please make sure you're using worlds that are for the right version, otherwise you may encounter issues!

Adds a simple button to the Singleplayer screen that lets you upload world .zip files and add them directly into your game quickly and easily, so importing worlds takes only a few seconds to finish setup!

![Import Zip Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e718b9f66de8014d8ad5e1b1b3a11f325f88cbce_0.webp)
